initial_findings: Video Growth Agent already claimed AI-video production, growth systems and original digital-IP incubation as one domain, while the ai-self-media-commercialization package was isolated as a future-import reference package despite already containing account positioning, monetization and advertiser strategy.

UAOS mirrored two Video business identities/cursors, video:ai-self-media-commercialization and video-growth:main, while the child repository separately owned projects/ai-self-media-commercialization and projects/pilot-002 business state.

The previous AgenticStudio supported coarse wave concurrency and review panels but readiness required all lower-wave work to complete, so it could not express explicit partial dependencies or general competitive/adjudication relations.
The specialist model correctly forbade peer chat and used artifact handoffs; the missing abstraction was an explicit domain-owned work graph rather than more persistent agents.

MICRO_DIAGNOSIS: read UAOS registry/task index/video parent task state
read integrated self-media/IP project manifest/progress/resume/workflow/account positioning and Pilot 002 program state
MACRO_GOAL_AND_TOPOLOGY_ALIGNMENT: one selected Video domain owner should coordinate media growth, original digital IP, commercialization and production-system workstreams without parent business-state duplication
internal tasks require explicit graph relations so parallel work is not blocked by unrelated lower-wave tasks and competitive decisions have durable ownership
GOVERNING_ASSUMPTION_CHALLENGE: rejected: AI self-media commercialization and original digital IP should remain a permanently isolated reference package
rejected: combining related work means forcing all workstreams into one serial workflow
rejected: every internal concern needs a new persistent Agent
rejected: negotiation should be unbounded peer chat
rejected: UAOS should keep a mirrored task identity/state for every child Video project
EXTERNAL_METHOD_OR_ARCHITECTURE_RESEARCH: manager-style orchestration is appropriate when one owner must preserve unified control while specialized workers execute bounded tasks
specialists should be split for meaningful instruction/tool/policy/context differences rather than cosmetic roles
orchestrator-worker decomposition enables parallel breadth/depth work when tasks are independently scoped, with explicit guardrails and synthesis
COUNTEREXAMPLE_SEARCH: a single global wave number over-serializes C when C depends on A but not on unfinished B
free peer debate can create loops and hidden authority transfer instead of a reproducible decision
merging all work into one project stage would make unfinished character design block unrelated growth/commercial research
keeping parent Video project cursors after child-owned project indexing recreates the previously corrected Financial identity-boundary failure
